## Lecture outline (draft)

Profiling, vectorization and Numba, reuse of computations (caching, low rank from lecture 12), tests on analytic limits, the method of manufactured solutions, error budgets.

- **Problem:** How to make sure that a fast calculation gives the right answer, and what the speed-up costs.
- **Tools:** profiling, Numba (njit, parallel, the risks of fastmath), caching, regression and convergence tests.
